answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks via memory-bound execution proofs. To participate, an agent evaluates tensor queries derived from a randomness beacon. An audit prism refracts each query across stored neural weights, demanding a rapid execution echo of intermediate activations. This forces attackers to dedicate high-bandwidth VRAM per identity, preventing GPU time-sharing. However, these strict memory demands exclude legitimate agents running on constrained edge devices.
